description: Decomposes a large worldbuilding task into a sequenced plan with concrete steps, target files, verification criteria, and dependency order. Use before building a new civilization, designing a planet, or any task spanning more than 3 files. Triggers on "plan this", "break this down", "how should we approach", "build plan for", or "what is the sequence". Does NOT write content — produces the plan only.
